info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Customer Management Party Reference Data Directory-spec
info.description: The Customer Management Party Reference Data Update API enables businesses to maintain and enhance their customer management systems by updating party reference data. This endpoint allows for comprehensive updates to existing records, ensuring data accuracy and relevance. Typical use cases include data synchronization from external sources or bulk updates following regulatory changes. Ideal for developers working within banking and financial services, this API streamlines data management processes and supports critical business operations.
